The table names chat navigation and branch UX, every provider-connection page, ordinary settings and onboarding, each installation and migration guide, every administration page, runtime-only audio image retrieval translation avatar and utility extensions, contributor workflows, and repository metadata. Each row states why it does not define a selected portable authoring contract. Together with the 21 inclusion rows, the manifest accounts for all 92 Markdown files. Macro names and operators remain governed by the stronger exhaustive catalogs rather than inferred from this coverage table.

sections.title: Dynamic boundaries
sections.summary: Dynamic boundaries states that live slash macros queries, field autocomplete, extension slash commands, and installed expression classifiers remain installation authorities outside the pinned markdown inventory. Hoplight never executes imported automation, STscript, or sealed scripts merely to discover what an installation can do. Capability claims must not be reverse-engineered by running untrusted content; they come from static documentation, adapters, and user-invoked sandboxed benches only.

sections.title: Refresh
sections.summary: Refresh requires comparing the next SillyTavern-Docs commit to the pinned hash, updating inclusion and exclusion destinations, re-running macro coverage tests, rewriting affected semantic summaries, and obtaining independent review after those summary rewrites. Do not advance the pin without reconciling every path-level verdict and regenerating author-valid sidecars for changed pages.
